regime_context: The detector shows broad thematic leadership (9 of 16 themes trend-eligible) but no single dominant narrative. Big Banks lead with a high durability trend, while momentum rank itself has no validated return edge — only the absolute-trend gate has backtested risk-control value. Track record shows past calls only marginally better than coin-flip on direction, so conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watching Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO, rank #2, score 0.915 but eligible=false, durability 0.23, breadth 0.214). The watch condition: XEG.TO achieves a durable trend tag (durability_bar above ~0.6) AND passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) for 10 consecutive trading days — that would retire the 'not-yet-trending' watch and confirm a leadership handoff toward energy.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the confirmed leader with the strongest combination of trend-gate eligibility, durability (0.8), and full breadth (1.0). The trend-gate is the one validated leg, and this theme is the cleanest expression of it. Crowding is low (z=0.7), so no size-down caution applies. This is a staying-power lean, not a momentum chase.
evidence: breadth 1.0 — broadest participation among all themes
eligible=true — passes the absolute-trend gate (the only validated edge)
theses.dissent: Financials leadership on the TSX is often late-cycle and rate-sensitive; if the macro backdrop shifts toward recession or credit stress, banks' trend can reverse sharply despite current breadth.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date, or breadth drops below 0.5.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Second strongest durable trend after Banks: durability_bar 0.82, full breadth (1.0), trend-tagged, and eligible. Defensive staple exposure fits the detector's risk-control purpose. Crowding is elevated (z=0.91) but not flagged crowded, so it is a size-down caution at most, not a fade.
evidence: crowding_z 0.91 — elevated but below the crowded threshold
theses.dissent: Consumer staples leadership can be a flight-to-safety signal; if risk appetite returns broadly to the TSX, defensives may lag cyclicals and this trend could stall.

falsifier.text: XST.TO underperforms ZEB.TO by 3% or more before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: A quiet but durable eligible trend (durability 0.8, breadth 0.917, trend-tagged) with negative crowding (z=-0.25) — no crowding concern at all. Offers diversification within the disciplined-trend basket. Low conviction because its rank is mid-pack and the momentum rank itself carries no edge.
theses.dissent: Rising rates or a re-steepening yield curve would pressure rate-sensitive utilities regardless of trend health.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 4% or more before the 20-day check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
